{{Quote|Ahsoka, surely you understand this is a pivotal moment in the Clone Wars. The heart of the Republic is under attack.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Old Friends" />}}
The '''Battle of Coruscant''', also known as the '''first Battle of Coruscant''', the '''Siege of Coruscant''', or the '''strike at Coruscant''', was a crucial battle that took place in [[19 BBY]] on the [[Ground warfare|surface]] and in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], the [[capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic]], during the waning [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. As the war began to progress to its closure, in which it appeared that the Republic's ultimate victory was inevitable with their opposition, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was trapped in a [[Outer Rim Sieges|series of sieges]] throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. In an attempt to turn the war in their favor, as the Republic's experienced [[officer]]s and [[Jedi General]]s were preoccupied with the Outer Rim Sieges, Separatist leaders Head of State Count Dooku and [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] launched a massive and unprecedented assault on the Republic capital, who were ordered by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Sidious]]—publicly known as [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine—to kidnap the Chancellor as part of his plot to bring [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] closer to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] of [[the Force]].

After they arrived in Coruscant's orbit without warning, Grievous's massive [[fleet]], [[Flagship|flagged]] by the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', was able to overwhelm and destroy most of the ill-prepared [[Coruscant Home Defense Fleet]]. As the two fleets [[Space warfare|engaged]] one another, the Separatist general managed to slip down to the planet's surface along with tens of thousands of other battle droids, where he was able to complete his mission and bring Chancellor Palpatine aboard his flagship following a prolonged chase through the [[Imperial City|Galactic City's]] [[Federal District]]. On the verge of their ultimate victory with the Chancellor taken [[prisoner]], which would thereby force the Republic to open negotiations with the Confederacy, Grievous was instead ordered by Dooku to remain in orbit and engage the Republic fleet at close quarters. However, despite their efforts, Republic reinforcements from across [[the galaxy]], including the [[Open Circle Fleet]]s, arrived and proceeded to engage the Separatist fleet, with the intent of preventing their escape while also laying waste to as many [[warship]]s as possible.

Amid the chaotic engagement, two [[Jedi]] Generals, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], taking advantage of its confusion, flew into the heart of the battle as they boarded Grievous's [[command ship]] following a prolonged struggle with several [[squadron]]s of [[droid starfighter]]s. Upon their infiltration of the ''Invisible Hand'', Kenobi and Skywalker were able to navigate themselves throughout the warship's interior to the Chancellor's location aboard the main observation platform, where they were confronted by the [[Sith Lord]] Dooku, who was defeated by Skywalker after a brief [[Lightsaber duel|duel]]. Subsequently, he was betrayed by Sidious, who, as Palpatine, had him executed by Skywalker. However, while making their escape, the two Jedi were captured and brought to the Kaleesh general aboard the command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], which resulted in a brief skirmish as they forced the general to flee the command ship and returned the Chancellor to the safety of the Republic.

Following Palpatine's return to safety alongside the losses of Count Dooku and a third of their deployed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|fleet]], Grievous became the Confederacy's new Head of State upon Dooku's [[death]] as he ordered the immediate withdrawal of his remaining forces and proceeded to flee into the Outer Rim. With Grievous's retreat, the Chancellor assured the Republic that the war would instead continue as long as the general still lived. As a result, the task of locating Grievous became the [[Jedi Order]]'s highest priority as they began to conduct extensive searches throughout the [[galaxy]].

==Prelude==
===On the verge of victory===
[[File:CoruscantGlobeE1.png|thumb|left|250px|For over a thousand years, Coruscant served as the seat of power and capital of the Galactic Republic.]]
After the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Mace Windu 1">[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]]</ref> at the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] had suspected that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had developed an intentive desire to reach<ref name="Mace Windu 1" /> the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[capital]] [[Planet|world]]<ref name="SWGA" /> of [[Coruscant]], located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Core Worlds]]. At such an early stage in the war, understanding that the Confederacy had continuously extended their reach throughout the vastness of the [[Outer Rim Territories]], Windu recounted how power often followed in concentric circles. He further postulated that, following the confederate government's acquisition of a foothold in the Outer Rim, they would proceed to follow through with their intentions and make their advancements on the interior regions, including Coruscant.<ref name="Mace Windu 1" />

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> as the war began the progress to its closure, in which it became apparent that the Republic's ultimate victory was inevitable,<ref name="Battles" /> the Confederacy had launched a major [[Outer Rim Sieges|offensive]] across the Outer Rim under the direct [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies]] [[General]] [[Grievous]]. With the Republic and its [[Republic Military|military]] pushed to the brink, the [[Jedi High Council]], in response, deployed many of their battle-hardened forces and experienced [[Jedi General]]s and officers to bolster their beleaguered [[clone trooper]]s and engage the confederate government.<ref name="Old Friends" /> However, while the engagements of the Outer Rim Sieges had proven to be attritional to the Confederacy, leading to the government's seeming entrapment, with military spending and requisition bills passing through the [[Galactic Senate]], accompanied by an increase in [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s, the momentum of the war appeared to be with the Republic.<ref name="Battles" />

Although the Republic saw many victories in their engagements, the government's deployment of its experienced and battle-ready forces had subsequently left [[the Interior]] and its capital of Coruscant with comparatively few defensive measures, such as by the ill-prepared [[Coruscant Home Defense Fleet]], commanded by<ref name="Front Lines" /> [[Commander]]<ref name="Battles" /> [[Honor Salima]], which had not been instructed on the procedures for possible full-scale attacks on the planet. Republic strategists also developed minimal worries as they believed that the Confederacy would not dare attempt such a desperate assault, which allowed them to focus their efforts on the Outer Rim Sieges while also leaving their capital sparsely defended. Furthermore, the citizens of Coruscant also had very little worries of such attacks, believing that the confederate government's ultimate surrender was near.<ref name="Front Lines" />

===Planning a countereffort===
[[File:Sidious_hologram.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Sidious had orchestrated an assault on Coruscant in order to lure Anakin Skywalker closer to the dark side and bring an end to the Clone Wars with himself on top.]]
Prior to the attack and sometime after his [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|loss]] of the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Malevolence]]'', Grievous had demanded he receive command and ownership over the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]'' from [[Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. In response, Gunray refused to comply with the general's demands, but later received direct orders from the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] and the Confederacy's shadow leader, [[Darth Sidious]], to transfer the [[dreadnought]]'s command to Grievous, much to the general's pleasure.<ref name="Separatist Ships">{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}}</ref> Afterward, as the [[Kaleesh]] general utilized the ''Invisible Hand'' in a series of skirmishes, Grievous and Confederate Head of State, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], were ordered by Sidious, Dooku's [[Sith Master|master]],<ref name="BMF 75" /> to conduct a massive assault on the Republic's capital, with the intention of capturing [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine, the [[Sith Lord]]'s public identity. As such, Sidious hoped the battle would be able to lure Dooku's nemesis [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] to the battle and [[Death|kill]] Dooku in order to bring him closer to the [[dark side of the Force]],<ref name="Episode III" /> while the Count had wrongly believed that the battle was arranged for him to claim victory over the Jedi Knight and so they could turn Skywalker together.<ref name="Battles" />

Dooku and Grievous also intended on using the battle as a way to secure a both a dramatic and decisive victory for the confederate government, as the Chancellor's capture would subsequently force the officers of [[Republic High Command]] to negotiate with the Confederacy and surrender deep concessions to them, while also gaining a massive [[Propaganda|propagandic]] victory.<ref name="Front Lines" /> As a result, it was believed that Sidious provided Grievous with the coordinates for the strategically valuable [[Nexus Route]] in order for him to facilitate the assault,<ref name="Battles" /> using the ''Invisible Hand'' as his [[flagship]].<ref name="Episode III" /> The Separatists thinned their forces during the Outer Rim Sieges to prepare their attack on Coruscant, though this came at a downside as the Republic was able to gain the upper hand in these battlefields.<ref name="OSWM 123" />

==The battle==
===Strike on Coruscant===
{{Quote|Chaos over Coruscant! We interrupt our usual broadcast to bring you breaking news: the Separatist Fleet has launched an attack on the heart of the Republic! Separatist warships have engaged the Coruscant Home Defense Fleet in orbit, and we are just now receiving reports that the ''Invisible Hand'', flagship of the dread General Grievous, has been sighted coming out of hyperspace. Here at ''Missives from the Front'', we strive to bring you coverage of the war as it rages through the farthest corners of the galaxy. Today, the Front has come home to us. We implore our listeners on Coruscant to keep listening as this story develops. Stay safe. We will prevail. Now more than ever, we are one people, one Republic!|''Missives from the Front'' reports on the battle|<ref name="SWZC" />}}
[[File:InvisibleHand-SWM.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Invisible Hand'' heralded the arrival of General Grievous and claimed several kills mere minutes after its arrival.]]
Upon their arrival alongside a massive Separatist fleet of over 1,000 warships flagged by the ''Invisible Hand'', Grievous launched a massive and unprecedented assault on the Republic capital, with all inhabitants on the planet's surface realizing upon the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} departure from hyperspace that the Kaleesh general was leading the attack. Grievous's [[command ship]] proceeded to engage the [[capital ship]]s and Star Destroyers of the [[Republic Navy]]'s planetary defense fleet. Within [[Standard minute|minutes]] of the assault's outbreak, the ''Invisible Hand'' had claimed multiple kills.<ref name="BMF 75" /> ''[[Missives from the Front]]'', a Republic-operated news broadcast, interrupted its normally scheduled broadcast to inform its listeners about the developing situation over Coruscant as soon as the battle broke out. The ''Missives'' news anchor urged their listeners on Coruscant to stay safe and informed, letting them know in the process that eye witness accounts to their station had confirmed the presence of the ''Invisible Hand''.<ref name="SWZC" />

{{GameMechanics|Star Wars Zero Company}}
The ''Missives from the Front'' broadcast was caught by [[Tesh Keff Hawks]], the leader of the [[Zero Company]] military outfit and a current ally to [[Republic Intelligence]], which had hired Hawks and Zero Company for its help in the [[Hunt for Kundri Fathom|campaign against]] the Separatist-aligned [[Infinite Coil]] [[Religion|cult]]. Hawks caught the broadcast about the outbreak of the battle in Zero Company's base of operations, [[the Den]], between their missions with intelligence.<ref name="SWZC" />
{{EndGame}}

[[File:DroidTriFighterSquadron-SWM.png|thumb|right|270px|Tri-fighters and other Separatist vessels during the battle.]]
With the inexperienced Coruscant Home Defense Fleet caught off guard and overwhelmed, the Separatist fleet was able to reduce a substantial amount of the defending Star Destroyers to flaming wreckage<ref name="BMF 75" /> and breached orbit, allowing for [[battle droid]]s to be landed into the planetary city of Coruscant.<ref name="MOF" /> Droid fighters on the surface supported the battle droids, spraying fire on the ground preventing [[Yoda]] and Mace Windu from moving so Grievous could act.<ref name="SWE Tanks Droids" /> Yoda would, however, use the Force to make attacking ships crash into each other.<ref name="Annual 2016">''[[Star Wars Annual 2016]]''</ref> As the two fleets engaged one another in orbit, the Kaleesh general proceeded with his mission to capture the Supreme Chancellor as he evaded the planet's defense forces and landed on Coruscant's surface in the Federal District alongside a strike force.<ref name="Front Lines" /> The Home Defense Fleet joined forces with Coruscant's [[Homeworld Security]] and other fleet groups for the battle.<ref name="OSWM 123" />

During the battle, battle droids stormed the [[Federal District]]<ref name="SWZC" /> and made their way to the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]],<ref name="MOF" /> which, along with its surrounding areas, would be consumed in flames. An [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]]<ref name="V-wing card">{{Destiny|set=Convergence|cardname=V-wing|link=https://swdestinydb.com/card/09137}}</ref> piloted by [[clone trooper pilot]] [[Contrail]]<ref name="SWZ80" /> flew across the skies above the burning district.<ref name="V-wing card" /> The battle that raged above also resulted in disastrous impacts on the vast [[Imperial City|Galactic City]] across the surface<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> even though the Separatist fleet never directly bombarded the planet, instead remaining focused on the capitol and the capture of Palpatine.<ref name="MOF" />

[[File:V-wing_SWDConv.png|thumb|left|300px|The Federal District was lit aflame during the Battle of Coruscant.]]
With each battleship that collided with the structures, the cityscape became scarred with a ten-[[kilometer]] crater, as well as subsequent shockwaves that leveled the structures within the vicinity of each crash. In response, confident rescue-service pilots from the [[Coruscant Rescue Ops]] worked tirelessly in countless civil emergency vehicles as they retrieved the crewmembers of doomed starships from the battle above, while also guiding the plummeting hulks to reduce the loss of civilian life and damage to the city.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> As a result of the extensive damage dealt to the planet's typically impenetrable shields following constant bombardments from the Separatist fleet, the Coruscant Rescue Ops were placed on twenty-four hour alert as all members were required to report to their districts,<ref name="BMF 46">{{BuildFalconCite|46|Starship Fact File}}</ref> where fire teams in [[F-143 emergency speeder]]s were deployed to patrol the skies above and douse and divert burning vessels that fallen through the atmosphere after losing repulsor power with their tractor beams,<ref name="Battles" /> or operate the busy service and refuelling stations.<ref name="BMF 46" />

===Capture of Palpatine===
{{Quote|And your people kidnapped Chancellor Palpatine. There were battle droids outside the Senate.|Mon Mothma, to [[Soujen Vak-Nhalis]]|<ref name="MOF" />}}
[[File:ShaakTiWotG.jpg|thumb|right|270px|During his pursuit of Chancellor Palpatine, Jedi Master Shaak Ti was engaged and incapacitated by Grievous, leading to the loss of her lightsaber.]]
After landing in the Galactic City, Grievous began his advancement on the Chancellor's position, who had been heavily guarded by Republic security forces and several Jedi, including<ref name="Lightsabers" /> Jedi Master<ref name="The End of the Clone Wars" /> [[Roron Corobb]].<ref name="Lightsabers" /> [[Palpatine's apartment]] had been escorted by Shaak Ti and Roron Corobb, along with clone troopers, who ordered him to leave. Although Palpatine ignored their concerns, deciding not to flee in the face of the Separatists attack, and then Grievous appeared, accompanied by his MagnaGuards.<ref name="The End of the Clone Wars">{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}}</ref> In his efforts and despite the Republic's actions to repel the general, Grievous was able to dispatch several layers of the Chancellor's security personnel and Corobb alongside, but had later come into a brief encounter with Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti]],<ref name="Lightsabers" /> who also engaged a number of his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s with an [[electrostaff]] in one hand and her [[Shaak Ti's lightsaber|lightsaber]] in the other.<ref name="Shaak Ti Five Stars">{{ForceCollection|Shaak Ti|star=5}}</ref> Despite Ti's efforts, Grievous had managed to triumph over the Jedi Master, and she was relinquished of her lightsaber following her incapacitation by the general's use of electrical cables.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

As such, the Kaleesh was able to capture the Chancellor and return to the ''Invisible Hand'' in orbit.<ref name="Front Lines" /> With the Separatists on the verge of their ultimate triumph over the Republic,<ref name="Battles" /> the officers of Republic High Command began to fear that, should the Confederacy escape with Palpatine, an immense psychological fallout would allow, along with the exposure of Coruscant's vulnerability. The Chancellor would possibly be subject to a show trial broadcast throughout the galaxy, which could thereby result in his subsequent execution. Alternatively, the Confederacy could bring High Command to the negotiating table, where the Republic would need to offer the confederate government deep concessions in return for Palpatine. To prevent either outcome, the ''Invisible Hand'' was made the Republic's primary target.<ref name="Front Lines" />

===Continued engagement===
{{Quote|Right now, people on Coruscant need us.''"<br />"''No. The Chancellor needs you.''"<br />"''That's not fair.''"<br />"''I'm not trying to be.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Old Friends" />}}
However, despite victory within reach, Grievous had instead received orders from Dooku to remain in the planet's orbit and continue to engage the Republic defense fleet at close quarters,<ref name="Battles" /> which had managed to organize itself into attack formations following the general's return to the ''Invisible Hand''.<ref name="Front Lines" /> As a result, the battle above Coruscant had become increasingly chaotic, with battle lines becoming blurred as they overlapped into three dimensions in the thousands of capital ships' attempts to gain elevation over their opponents by utilizing the planet's atmosphere as a foundation. Furthermore, with the close proximity of either sides' warships to each other, the weapon systems of both the Republic and Confederacy's starships, such as the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} array of [[mass-driver cannon]]s, were utilized to great and devastating effect during broadside engagements as vessels crossed paths.<ref name="Battles" />

[[File:SiegeOfCoruscantScenarioPack-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|The space battle raged between starfighters and capital ships.]]
After Grievous's return, the Coruscant Home Defense Fleet's vessels received orders from Commander Honor Salima to close the Confederacy's hyperspace jump point and blockade the ''Invisible Hand'' in order to prevent its extrication and provide time for the arrival of Republic reinforcements from all across the galaxy. Following the arrival of reinforcements, including hundreds of warships from the [[Open Circle Fleet]], Grievous had rallied his remaining capital ships as they began to trade fire with the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers,<ref name="Front Lines" /> while also employing a [[Brawl]] tactic in order to exploit the limited reactions of the droid crews and commanders<ref name="BMF 89">{{BuildFalconCite|89|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref> as they fought with an intentive desire to maximize the Confederacy's casualties, resulting in a free for all between the two forces. The Republic fleet also sought to destroy as many of their warships as possible, as well as prevent their withdrawal, forcing the Separatist capital ships of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleships]], [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], and [[Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]],<ref name="Front Lines" /> including the ''[[Patriot Fist]]'',<ref name="Armada" /> to battle the Republic for their very survival, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides.<ref name="Front Lines" /> Meanwhile, starfighter squadrons of either fleet had fought to exploit openings and increase damage to vessels without shielding systems or with damaged shields.<ref name="Battles" />

While the two fleets continued their engagements of one another, Jedi General Saesee Tiin, alongside a force of clone troopers had launched from the Star Destroyer ''[[Impavid]]'' to the Confederacy's ''Providence''-class Dreadnought ''[[Prosperous]]'', resulting in the destroyer's capture by the Republic.<ref name="BMF 58" /> As the Republic fought to ensure the Confederacy's inability to withdraw, specifically the ''Invisible Hand'', the confederate government's battle plan had become less apparent as a result of the battle, but had instead appeared that their intentions were to cripple the Republic's fleet, with the space above the planet becoming choked by shattering hulks and flaming wreckage. However, despite the strategies employed by both fleets, the chaotic engagement itself had swiftly descended into local battles between nearby warships alongside support from [[starfighter]]s, which filled the gaps of space between the capital ships. Furthermore, signs of coherent control from the military commanders of either force had begun to collapse, with targets of military worth becoming neglected as warships fired on those of convenience or proximity.<ref name="Battles" />

====Duel with a Sith====
{{Quote|Get help. You're no match for him. He's a Sith Lord.''"<br />"''Chancellor Palpatine, Sith Lords are our speciality.|Palpatine and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=SithLordSpeciality-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
[[File:Dookuepisodeiii.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The duel on the ''Invisible Hand''.]]
Before the Jedi were able to release Palpatine, [[Darth]] Tyranus, publicly known as Count Dooku, arrived with two B2 super battle droids. He jumped down from the balcony and engaged the Jedi in a fierce duel. However as a result of his old body, he found himself unable to fight both Skywalker and Kenobi concurrently; he then [[Force push]]ed Kenobi away from the duel so he could focus on solely fighting Skywalker. However, Dooku still began to tire as Skywalker drove him back up the stairs to the balcony. Kenobi, quickly recovering, brought down the Sith Lord's escort and continued to attempt an attack on him from behind.<ref name="Episode III" />

Dooku, however, simply kicked aside Skywalker and incapacitated Kenobi more permanently by slamming him into a railing with the Force and causing debris to fall on him. Angered, Skywalker kicked Dooku back off the balcony and once again engaged him. Sensing that Skywalker was holding back his anger and hate, Dooku taunted him, hoping to disrupt his concentration. However, it had the opposite effect. It infuriated Skywalker to the point where he tapped into the dark side. He attacked Dooku with his rage and hatred, throwing fast, heavy attacks against the Sith Lord. Dooku could barely deflect his opponent's blows, let alone fight back, and was even ''singed'' by his own blade at one point. Finally, Skywalker managed to overpower Dooku's defense and sever his hands. Grabbing Dooku's lightsaber with his offhand, he held both blades in a scissor position around the now defenseless Sith Lord's neck.<ref name="Episode III" />

Still bound to his chair, Palpatine commended Skywalker's victory, before ordering the Jedi Knight to kill Dooku, thus betraying his apprentice. Shocked by his own master's order and betrayal, Dooku looked at Palpatine with a look of shock on his face, only to be met with a more sinister smile by his master. Skywalker was hesitant at first, as killing a defenseless opponent—which Dooku now was—was against the Jedi way. However, with Sidious goading him on and saying ''do it'', he gave in to his hatred and beheaded Count Dooku.<ref name="Episode III" /> The Confederacy of Independent Systems was. thus, left without its leader, founder, and main political figure.<ref name="Front Lines" />

====Confrontation with Grievous====
{{Quote|Ah, yes, the negotiator: General Kenobi. We've been waiting for you. Amid the battle in space, [[Republic officer]]s used a [[Brawl]] tactic against the enemy fleet, which would prove to exploit the weakness of the droid captains aboard Separatist craft.<ref name="BMF 89" /> After the Jedi, Palpatine, and Artoo were brought aboard<ref name="Episode III" /> the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}}<ref name="Grievous DB" /> bridge, the cyborg general mocked Skywalker and his nemesis on their failed rescue and took their lightsabers from an [[OOM command battle droid]], noticing that Anakin Skywalker was in front of him, finally meeting him face-to-face, both mocking one another, Skywalker angering Grievous in the process. Boasting about adding their lightsabers to his collection, Kenobi assured Grievous that this time he wouldn't escape. After a quick battle, the Jedi easily defeated the droids and freed Palpatine from the grip of two security droids. Grievous ordered the crew to keep the ship in orbit, but soon the pair of Jedi closed in on the cyborg, intent on capturing him. Grievous, however, grabbed an [[electrostaff]] that one of his MagnaGuards had dropped and threw it into the damaged bridge [[viewport]], shattering it.<ref name="Episode III" />

[[File:Handsplits.png|thumb|left|220x220px|The ''Invisible Hand'' splits in half.]]
Grievous allowed himself to be sucked out into space to escape the Jedi, but used a grappling hook to secure himself to the ''Invisible Hand'' and later re-entered the ship through a hatch. The [[Neimoidian]]s and [[OOM pilot battle droid]]s quickly abandoned the bridge, and some of the [[pilot droid]]s were cut down by the Jedi.<ref name="Episode III" /> In an attempt to foil the Jedi's escape, Grievous launched every escape pod on his flagship, fleeing in one, and his pod was recovered by the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]]<ref name="CL 2016" /> ''[[Profusion]]''. The ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} hull sagged under the pressure of Coruscant's [[gravity well]],<ref name="Front Lines" /> and began a meteoric plunge toward Coruscant.<ref name="Episode III" />

[[File:IH_landing.png|thumb|right|245x245px|The ''Invisible Hand'' lands on Coruscant toward the end of the battle.]]
The ship's internal gravity quickly switched polarities due to the gravity well,<ref name="Front Lines" /> but despite everything Skywalker took control of the helm, and attempted to pilot the wreck to a safe landing on Coruscant. Rapidly losing structural integrity, the entire rear half of the ''Invisible Hand'' tore off due to the atmospheric stress<ref name="Episode III" /> and the loss of the ship's [[tensor field]]s. Oddball witnessed the ship fall and break in half, and he later said that he didn't expect that the Jedi would survive.<ref name="Front Lines" /> In spite of the heavy damage, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Artoo managed to successfully crash-land the ship on a long<ref name="Episode III" /> emergency<ref name="Front Lines" /> runway in Galactic City. With the loss of their flagship, the failure of their main objective, and the death of Count Dooku;<ref name="Episode III" /> Grievous and the surviving elements of the depleted Separatist armada retreated in disgrace. Not all ships could follow however, as a third of the armada<ref name="Front Lines" /> deployed to Coruscant<ref name="Bust Collection 37" /> had been lost, whether it was due to engine damage, critical ship failures or destruction. More ships under the command of organics like Neimoidians or [[Muun]]s surrendered, but droid starfighters did not. It took [[Standard hour|hours]] for clone pilots to clear out the rest of the vulture droids, tri-fighters, and [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|Hyena bombers]].<ref name="Front Lines" />

==Aftermath==
===Immediate aftermath===
{{Quote|Count Dooku is dead! We repeat, Count Dooku is dead! At last, the horrific battle over Coruscant's home skies has ended, with General Grievous and his fleet beating a desperate retreat and our kidnapped Chancellor returning safely home in the hands of Jedi heroes Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker. Questions abound: does Count Dooku's death portend a close to the war? Where will General Grievous and his droid army strike next? How did the Separatist managed such a savage strike so deep into the poor worlds? We can say no more than this: though our Republic warriors have once again prevailed in the face of abject villany, the sight of battle droids storming our Federal District will not soon depart the Coruscanti consciousness. This has been your ''Missive from the Front'' — and a grim reminder that this front is often closer to home than we dare to imagine. One people, one Republic!|''Missives from the Front'' reports on the battle|<ref name="SWZC" />}}
Palpatine was quickly returned to the Republic, where he was greeted by various [[senator]]s and Master Windu. After landing on the capital, Obi-Wan returned to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], and Skywalker went with the group of politicians. Palpatine praised the heroics of the Jedi who had rescued him and mentioned how they had killed Count Dooku, but how Grievous had once again escaped. Palpatine informed Windu that the Senate would continue the war as long as Grievous lived since he now had taken Count Dooku's place as the leader of the Separatist Alliance, so Windu made sure the Jedi's top priority would be finding the General. Skywalker briefly talked with Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] as Artoo reunited with [[C-3PO]]. Skywalker then secretly met with his [[Marriage|wife]], [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], and it was their first meeting in some time, as the Jedi Knight had been away fighting the Outer Rim Sieges. There Padmé revealed that she was pregnant, and she questioned what they would do because she knew Skywalker was a Jedi and marriage was against the Jedi Order's rules but her husband told her not to worry about it for now because this was the happiest moment of his life.<ref name="Episode III" />

After the battle, Oddball gave a post-mission summary of flight squad seven's mission. The pilot went over their launch to the destruction of the ''Invisible Hand''. The pilot mentioned that after he saw the CIS flagship break in half that he believed that the Jedi would not escape.<ref name="Front Lines" /> Meanwhile, the greater Republic was informed of the battle's end and Dooku's death. ''Missives from the Front'' reported on the battle as a major development in the war and grim reminder of how easily danger could strike against even the Core Worlds.

===Aftershocks of Dooku's death===
{{Quote|Soon I will have a new apprentice, one far younger and more powerful.|Darth Sidious, conferring with General Grievous after the battle|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
Dooku's death at the hands of Skywalker precluded the Jedi from learning more about Darth Sidious. When Tano informed Kenobi during the Siege of Mandalore that Maul had knowledge about his old master, Kenobi asked them to capture Maul so he could reveal Sidious' public identity to the Jedi Council.<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice">{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}}</ref>

[[File:Kenobi_faces_Grievous_ROTS.png|thumb|right|251x251px|Grievous and Kenobi had one last duel on Utapau]]
The Separatists were dealt a crippling loss from Coruscant,<ref name="Front Lines" /> with an entire third of the fleet they had deployed into the battle lost.<ref name="Bust Collection 37" /> Worse than that though was the loss of their leader, Count Dooku. After his death, Grievous became the Confederacy's new [[Head of State]],<ref name="Front Lines" /> but it greatly destabilized the Separatist control structure.<ref name="Episode III" />

Without the assurances of victory from Dooku, the members of the Separatist Council, particularly Viceroy Nute Gunray, began to doubt the abilities of their new leader to keep them safe for much longer. Meanwhile, the [[Jedi High Council]] made tracking down Grievous and bringing him to justice their utmost priority in hope of finally ending the war. The [[Jedi Order]] would go on to track him to [[Utapau]], where they launched an [[Battle of Utapau|assault]] in which Kenobi confronted and killed Grievous<ref name="Episode III" /> only a few days after the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="Front Lines" />

===Lasting consequences===
[[File:Bowing_before_a_New_Master.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Anakin Skywalker becomes Darth Sidious' new apprentice.]]
During the Battle of Utapau, Palpatine successfully achieved his goal of [[Duel in Palpatine's office|converting Skywalker to the dark side of the Force]] and took the fallen Jedi Knight as his new and last [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], thus replacing Count Dooku, in return for saving his wife from her death. The Chancellor dubbed Skywalker as "Darth Vader" and executed [[Order 66]], branding the Jedi as traitors and creating media that the Jedi were behind the whole Clone Wars. With the Jedi Order destroyed, Palpatine transformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] and named himself as its [[Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="Episode III" />

The Battle of Coruscant had shown that dangers existed close to Coruscant, and this meant Palpatine faced almost no opposition to expanding the military and making a central authority. The Clone Wars had finally ended and while the galaxy had technically achieved peace, it was at the cost of freedom.<ref name="Front Lines" /> As recounted in [[Hondo Ohnaka]]'s ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', falling debris from the orbital combat left scars that marred Coruscant's cityscape for [[Standard decade|decades]].<ref name="GEG">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>

The Battle of Coruscant was created for the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode III" />

In the DVD commentary for ''Revenge of the Sith'', [[George Lucas]] said that he wanted the Battle of Coruscant to serve as a bridge between the [[Prequel trilogy|prequel]] and [[original trilogy]], utilizing ARC-170s as the precursor to [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]], and including vulture droids from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="DVD commentary">{{Film|III}} DVD commentary</ref> Anakin Skywalker's and Obi-Wan Kenobi's fraternal relationship through the battle is unmistakable from the [[1930s|1939]] classic film [[Wikipedia:Gunga Din (film)|''Gunga Din'']].<ref name="Gunga Din Reference">{{SW|url=news/the-cinema-behind-star-wars-gunga-din|text=The Cinema Behind ''Star Wars'': ''Gunga Din''|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:ShaakTiStab.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Shaak Ti dying at the hands of Grievous in a deleted scene.]]
Originally, the Battle of Coruscant was first developed as one of a montage of planets, as the initial story of Episode III was to open with a series of Clone Wars battles across the galaxy.<ref name="Cato Neimoidia's Databank">{{DB|location|catoneimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}}</ref> Another unused idea was that Shaak Ti was intended to die during the battle, impaled through her heart by General Grievous aboard the ''Invisible Hand''. Though this scene was present in the storyboards and early drafts for the film, it was deleted from the final cut of the film.<ref name="Insider 87">[[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]]</ref> Likewise, an idea dropped in the early stages of writing had Palpatine revealing to Anakin that Dooku paid the [[Tusken Raider]]s to kill his mother so Skywalker's hatred could be fueled to kill Dooku.<ref name="Dooku Behind">{{WebCite|url=http://imaginarycinema.com/sith.html|text=STAR WARS EPISODE III REVENGE OF THE SITH (2005)|work=[http://imaginarycinema.com Imaginary Cinema]|archivedate=20160520012229}}</ref>
